correctness.rationale: The Gaussian coherent-state overlap gives the double interaction J=∫∫exp(−π|x−y|²). Differentiating radial domain cutoffs twice and imposing exact volume preservation cancels the potential/curvature terms, leaving J''(0)=2R^(2N−2)e^(−t)∑(Λ_m(t)−Λ_1(t))||u_m||². Funk–Hecke with ordinary sphere area gives Λ_m=(2π)^(N/2)t^(1−N/2) I_(m+N/2−1)(t), t=2πR². The positive Bessel integral and integration by parts imply 0<I_(ν+1)<I_ν for t>0, so degree-one is null and degree-two uniquely minimizes the positive transverse gap. Small/large t expansions yield G~2π v_N R^(2N) and G~(N+1)R^(N−3)/(4π). Independent direct Gegenbauer quadrature matched 45 Bessel multipliers over N=4,6,8 and 9 endpoint-normalization checks. This is fixed smooth equal-volume star-shaped second variation, not global finite-amplitude stability.
